pages.title: A river with a master
pages.text: Trees here grow straight out of the water.

pages.title: What is here
pages.text: $(li)$(l:river/richnytsia)Richnytsia$(/l): a plant that grants Conduit Power;$(li)$(l:river/vodyanyk)The Vodianyk$(/l): king of the river;$(li)$(l:river/vodyanytsia)Vodianytsias$(/l): singing dwellers of the water.$(br2)Not everything that lives in the water wants you drowned. But some creatures may do it even with no ill intent.
